biological_prediction: Individual-specific fine-scale place-by-height organization should replicate in a different bat species and region: a bat's other nights should predict its vertical state better than other bats from the same site-year cohort, and the identity signal should be stronger conditionally on place than as a marginal height preference.

exclusions.deployment_manipulation: exclude reference deployments whose manipulation_type is present and not 'none'

session.self_training: other eligible sessions of the same individual within the same cohort

cohort.definition: exact Movebank study_site × shifted-night calendar year
cohort.shifted_night_rule: timestamp minus 12 hours, then calendar date

horizontal.projection_rule: per cohort, UTM zone selected from median longitude/latitude before numeric height is parsed

vertical.semantics: native GPS height above reference ellipsoid; not AGL and not MSL

probability_model.target_scoring: only target fixes whose horizontal cell is supported by both predictors

primary_endpoints.identity_x_location_increment: conditional identity gain - marginal identity gain
primary_endpoints.aggregation: equal-session within individual, then equal-individual across the entire admitted panel; cohort summaries also reported

required: more than half of evaluable individuals have positive conditional identity gain
conditional identity gain exceeds marginal identity gain

claim_boundary: replication concerns vertical flight-use organization, not foraging
ellipsoid height is not terrain-relative height
observational repeatability is not intrinsic personality or causation
site-year stratification prevents geographic/year identity from serving as the population baseline
